name: Shinsen
tagline: Shibuya in 2 minutes and Shinjuku in 12 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥150,000 to ¥160,000.
summary: The station is in Shibuya City, where Keio run 1 line between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 26 minutes to Otemachi, 12 minutes to Shinjuku, 2 minutes to Shibuya and 28 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥150,000 to ¥160,000. The station stands 26.9 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 7.8 m. The land around the station is close to level.

terrain.note: The station sits lower than the ground around it, at 26.9 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 26.9 m to 34.7 m, a difference of 7.8 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls outside the projected inundation area. Even so, 1 of the nine points within 400 m fall inside the area, and the deepest projection there is less than 0.5 m. On the whole, the flood projection here is among the smallest in the 23 wards.

groceries.name: ファミリーショップ もりおかや

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 9 clinics and 17 pharmacies. Day-to-day care is available close to the station. The nearest hospital is 明生会セントラル病院分院, about 5 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 明生会セントラル病院, about 7 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Keio Inokashira Line.
congestion: Keio Inokashira Line runs at 125% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 池ノ上→駒場東大前, which this station is not on. At 100%, the ministry's scale describes every passenger either seated or able to hold a strap or pillar. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥150,000 to ¥160,000 and 1K ¥140,000 to ¥150,000. 1LDK ¥240,000 to ¥250,000 and 2LDK ¥370,000 to ¥380,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥150,000 to ¥160,000. For 1LDK, 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: Shibuya is ahead on the number of lines and how close the centre is, but Shinsen is ahead on quiet.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Shinsen. It reaches Otemachi 7 minutes sooner than Shinsen.

neighbours.lead: rents are lower at Komaba-Todaimae, but Shinsen is ahead on the number of medical facilities and how easy the shopping is.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Shinsen. It reaches Otemachi in about the same time as Shinsen. One-room rents run about ¥34,000 lower.

goodFor: People who get around by bicycle or with a pushchair
People who want to finish their shopping on foot
notFor: People who want another route when service is suspended
People who want to hold the rent down
noiseSources: The 首都高速3号渋谷線 viaduct runs just outside the station. It is an expressway, so traffic is audible day and night
The nearest big road, 旧山手通り, is far enough that little traffic noise reaches the station area

leads.terrain: The ground around the station is almost level, so you can choose where to live without thinking about slopes.
leads.groceries: There are 13 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 1 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself is outside the projected flood area, but blocks nearby are inside it.
leads.stationNote: Only the Keio Inokashira Line serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are on the high side.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is on the high side for the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Among the 23 wards' stations, the lines here are very lightly loaded in the morning.
leads.noiseSources: Whether a flat faces the road changes what you hear indoors.
